MILESTONE
SHIPPED: Full test suite for Whisnap iOS at commit de125e0 (March 2026)
SIGNIFICANCE: 36 files changed, +5645/-402. First real test coverage.
ENABLES: Regression protection for models, services, concurrency bugs

WHAT'S REAL (kept):
- WebSocketModels Codable tests — catch API wire format breaks
- RecordingValidation / HistoryEntity / Settings model tests — boundary conditions
- AudioFileConverter WAV header tests — byte-level correctness
- RelayFlowIntegrationTests — actual byte contract between app and keyboard via App Group shared files
- StressTests (~16) — rapid start/stop cycling, Keychain thread safety, memory pressure
- ConcurrencyTests (~15) — race conditions, concurrent WebSocket calls
- RealWebSocketIntegrationTests (~6) — actual WSS to staging, XCTSkip if no token
- E2E XCUITests (3 files, ~15 tests) — real navigation, onboarding, recording states

WHAT WAS REMOVED:
- Mock theater: ViewModels that just verified mock wiring
- 41 math tests for NetworkQualityMonitor
- XCUITests needing launch args the app didn't support
- testStartStopCyclePerformance (crashed in measure block)

PRODUCTION CODE CHANGES:
- 2 protocol files: WebSocketClientProtocol, AudioCaptureServiceProtocol
- CloudTranscriptionService init widened to protocol types
- Whisnap_IOSApp.swift: #if DEBUG test data injection via launch arguments
- KeyboardState moved to Shared target
